decision.observation: 5 mph, gear 1, three dots lit. The car is on the pale strip just right of the dark lane, heading up-frame directly at the Nimkäädel arch; the puddled lane with EXHAUST banners runs up-left to it, a red house sits left of frame, and thin trees and pines are on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The heading already points at the arch, and the lane narrows toward it, so the car should converge onto the tarmac without a steer. Plain W builds speed and brings the arch closer.
decision.memory: Letting the converging lane edge meet the car's straight heading has avoided the speed-killing left steers that kept failing here.
